adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, evt.destinationCalendar is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code tries to add other hosts' calendars via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, this optional-chained push is a no-op, so `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from other hosts is silently dropped. This is a concrete, diff-verifiable behavior mismatch for the intended collective multi-calendar logic.
